title: XZ signature
summary: An XZ file begins with the 6-byte magic 0xFD 0x37 0x7A 0x58 0x5A 0x00 ('\xFD7zXZ\x00').
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: XZ uses LZMA2 compression with integrity checks (CRC32, CRC64, or SHA-256).
XZ is used by Linux kernel module compression, tar, and package managers.
